uiConfig.name: API Key
uiConfig.description: Authenticate using a HubSpot Service Key

fields.label: Service Key
fields.note: Requires scopes crm.lists.read, crm.lists.write, and crm.objects.contacts.read. crm.objects.contacts.write is not needed. Setup only proves list-read access. Prefer a HubSpot Service Key; legacy private-app tokens are accepted for compatibility. See https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/authentication/account-service-keys
